scope: Complete energy miniature with Claude realism round 1, persistent Fly exit pose and authored service fleet; see docs/three-worlds/MAP-REALISM.md and evidence/nav-activity/CHECKPOINT.md; W02 procedural mining miniature and shared world shell

assets.name: Three.js r180 and selected official addons
assets.modifications: Selected modules vendored without source changes; custom bloom alpha compositor lives outside vendor.

assets.name: Rock Face 01 derived cliff
assets.creator: Dario Barresi
assets.modifications: 1K glTF source imported to Blender; welded coincident vertices; 0.14-unit inward solid thickness; dark edge/back material; 0.72 decimation; exported GLB. Imported scanned surface has tiny remaining nonmanifold features recorded in validation; not claimed watertight.

assets.name: Rock Face diffuse
assets.modifications: Unmodified 1K JPG; used in local triplanar rock shader.

assets.name: Rock Face normal
assets.modifications: Unmodified 1K OpenGL normal JPG; lightweight local micro-normal detail.

assets.name: Pine Tree 01 twig diffuse atlas
assets.creator: Rico Cilliers / Rob Tuytel
assets.modifications: Unmodified 1K JPG; needle branch region selected through geometry UVs, not an edited bitmap.

assets.name: Pine Tree 01 twig opacity atlas
assets.modifications: Unmodified 1K PNG; alpha-tested foliage cards intentionally two-sided.

assets.name: Fallback poster
assets.license: Project-authored derivative with CC0 scene assets
assets.modifications: Resized and JPEG encoded from actual browser scene; used only for failure fallback.

assets.name: Procedural geometry, local environment, mist and room
assets.modifications: Deterministic geometry/materials and CSS room. Birb was inspected for concepts; no Birb code or media copied.

assets.name: Dense fir needle bough cutout
assets.source: Generated with built-in image generation for this project, 17 October 2026
assets.modifications: 768 px WebP derivative preserving alpha. Applied to radial 3D bough surfaces around closed tree cores; not a full-tree billboard.

assets.name: Static control-room background plate
assets.source: Generated with built-in image generation for this project, 17 October 2026
assets.modifications: WebP compression; CSS fixed background layer only, independent of the real rotating miniature.

assets.name: Shared cliff material textures
assets.modifications: Extracted embedded textures from the existing derived GLB; used for coherent triplanar rock colour and surface bump.

assets.name: Complete miniature authored procedural infrastructure
assets.modifications: Closed parametric basins, lattice steel, explicit cable curves, batched facades, roads and glass sheets. Asphalt tile generated deterministically at runtime. No new external assets.

assets.name: Mining terrain, industrial kits, vehicles and actual render poster
assets.source: Project-authored procedural geometry, materials and browser scene capture
assets.license: Project-authored; shared vendor/environment assets retain their entries above
assets.modifications: Deterministic seed/time, animated haulage, excavator, ore conveyors, mills and water arms. No third-party mining models or paid assets.

assets.name: Optional AI Lab observation layer
assets.modifications: Only enabled by experience=lab; stable multi-hotspot bindings, synthetic geometry and scripted conditions, no inference or equipment control.
